response.justification: While Bogdan possesses over 15 years of software development experience and strong expertise in building developer tools, testing frameworks, and CI/CD pipelines, he lacks the necessary people management background for a Level II Manager role. His career has been strictly on the Individual Contributor (IC) track as a Senior and Staff Engineer. Because the position requires a full-time people-leader capable of managing performance, setting organizational priorities, and conducting regular one-on-ones, he is not a suitable fit for this specific management level.
strengths: Over 15 years of software engineering experience with a strong focus on technical craftsmanship.
Proven track record of building developer tools, testing frameworks (Fluent-Asserts, Trial), and CI/CD infrastructure.
Relevant exposure to mobile platforms through iOS app development and mobile device orchestration tooling.
concerns: No demonstrated experience in formal people management, conducting 1-on-1s, or performance evaluations.
Lacks the required minimum of 2 years in people management and preferred experience leading organizational change.
Career trajectory is strictly aligned with an Individual Contributor path, making a direct jump to Level II Manager highly difficult.
